name: Summer Kitchen, Saint-Hippolyte
lede: In Saint-Hippolyte, an installer fitted out an open summer kitchen. The brief asked for heat spread along a long prep-and-dining zone rather than one piece over a table, so Tungsten heaters sit in the structure and do their job.
data: Tungsten Smart-Heat® – electric or gas, and quantity, to confirm
beats: An open summer kitchen with a Dekton counter, a barbecue and a smoker. One page of the installer’s describes it facing a lake, another as a pavilion by a pool.
The space is open and exposed, and the heat had to reach along a long prep-and-dining zone.
Mughet integrated Bromic Tungsten infrared heaters into the structure. An architect and the design studio Les Coupables worked on the project.
